Dedupe words: `two different seats claim one card` · `cross-session ownership transfer printed green` · `claimRepeats author test` · `p1 escalation condition measured` · `12 open cards two authors` · `#18828 sibling reading`.

## The reading (the #18828 dev's sweep, 2026-09-18T00:47:37Z–00:48:42Z; may have moved since)

- Population: every open card on both boards `check-clause2-carriers.mjs` reads — 529 open in objectstack-ai/objectstack, 413 in objectstack-ai/objectui (942); 880 carry at least one comment and were read; 163 carry at least one `Claim:` comment; 9 comment lists sit at the 100-comment cap and are UNJUDGED past it (#18683); 0 parse failures. Read through the gate's own `markerMatches` / `CLAIM_COMMENT_MARKER` and `claimRetractions` — the same readers governance uses.
- **12 open cards carry LIVE `Claim:` comments from two or more DIFFERENT authors with no retraction between them**: objectstack **#13503** (claude[bot] + baozhoutao) · **#14026** (hotlong + claude[bot]) · **#15811** (os-bill + os-litant) · **#17852** (os-warren + os-litant); objectui **#4730** (yinlianghui + os-sales) · **#7070** (os-warren + claude[bot]) · **#7696** (os-justin + os-tesla) · **#7804** (os-tesla + os-sam + os-justin) · **#7848** (claude[bot] + baozhoutao) · **#7924** (os-warren + os-sales) · **#8115** (claude[bot] + yinlianghui) · **#9370** (os-tesla + os-justin).
- What every reader does with them today: `claimCarrierSelection` takes the newest live claim that parses a branch as the governing claim and prints the older one as 「a SUPERSEDED claim」 at exit 0 — the newer seat's `Branch:` and `Clause-②` lines are what every downstream reader is handed. The protocol's only sanctioned hand-over is a `Release:` by the holder (AGENTS.md / SKILL.md; PR #18770's retraction channels); none of the twelve carries one. ⇒ ownership moved on twelve cards and nothing said so — the triage's phrase: 「那一刻读者会把所有权静默转走,并印成绿的」.
- Two same-author extremes surfaced by the same sweep, for the record (they are #18828's shape, not this card's): objectstack #13799 carries `claude[bot]` ×38 live claim comments; objectui #8071 carries `os-warren` ×10. PR #18859's C8 names each in ONE row.

## Shape (⛔ a proposal, not a prescription)

The reader that lands with PR #18859 (`claimRepeats`, grouped BY AUTHOR, the author test load-bearing — leg B of its ablation reds pin (b)) is the obvious sibling: a second grouping ACROSS authors — two or more live claims by different authors with no `Release:` between — is a NAMED state with its own row, its own remedy sentence (the holder posts `Release:`; the taker posts nothing until then), and exit 4. ⛔ Not a widening of C8: the remedy differs (a correction cannot repair a hand-over) and the direction is pinned silent in C8's battery on purpose. Whether an existing takeover by a different session after >24 h of silence (the lazy-liveness reclaim in SKILL.md) should read as sanctioned — and how the reader would know — is the protocol question this card carries; the twelve rows above are the population to test any rule against.
